<p class="homepage-purpose">I help local and state governments, nonprofits, startups, and academic institutions turn research insights, public data, and community voices into interactive stories and digital tools. Working across research, design, engineering, and communications teams, I combine qualitative and quantitative research, data analysis, human-centered design, and data visualization to create data experiences that help people learn, organizations make better decisions, and communities drive change in public health, climate justice, and health equity.</p>

## Stories & Data Visualizations

I design and build static, interactive, and scrollytelling experiences using R, D3.js, Svelte, Highcharts, Flourish, QGIS, Git/GitHub, and HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
